name: Spaghetti Bolognese
instructions: Heat olive oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add finely chopped onion, garlic, carrot and celery; sauté until softened.
Add the minced beef and cook until browned.
Stir in tomato sauce, season with salt and pepper, and simmer for 20 minutes.
Cook spaghetti according to package instructions.
Drain spaghetti and combine with the Bolognese sauce.
Serve hot.

name: Beef Chili
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add chopped onion and garlic; sauté until translucent.
Add minced beef and brown thoroughly.
Stir in chili powder, cumin, salt and pepper.
Add canned diced tomatoes and kidney beans; bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Serve hot with optional toppings.

name: Shepherd's Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C (390°F).
In a skillet, melt butter and sauté onion, garlic, carrot until softened.
Add minced beef and cook until browned.
Stir in peas, beef broth, salt and pepper; simmer until mixture thickens.
Transfer the meat mixture to a baking dish.
Spread mashed potatoes evenly over the top.
Bake for 25‑30 minutes until the topping is golden.
Allow to rest briefly before serving.
